title: Tier 0 + Tier 1 workflows
summary: .github/workflows/benchmark-pr.yml — CodSpeed smoke tests on every push plus PR-gated round-trip-count and correctness-invariant checks, reusing the existing Db2 container job.
description:
Write `.github/workflows/benchmark-pr.yml` implementing Tier 0 (pytest-codspeed instruction counting on BM-7's micro-benchmarks, no database, every push) and Tier 1 (BM-8/BM-9's write/read-path benchmarks against a 1k-row seeded corpus, reusing the existing Db2 container job from `ci.yml` verbatim — no new infrastructure to operate). Wire `github-action-benchmark` to publish results to `gh-pages` with `alert-threshold: 150%` (comment only) and `fail-threshold: 300%` (hard fail) for wall-clock, per Finding 5's guidance that GHA wall-clock is noisy and must never be a hard gate on its own. Hard-fail independently on any round-trip-count regression (BM-5's counter — deterministic, runner-invariant) or any correctness-invariant violation (leak count > 0, etc., per Phase 5.1's invariant table).

Acceptance: total added PR wall-clock is <=25 minutes; a deliberately injected extra `SELECT` in a hot path fails the round-trip gate; a deliberate 2x wall-clock slowdown produces a PR comment but does not fail the build; the trend chart renders correctly on `gh-pages`. Depends on BM-7, BM-8, BM-9, and BM-5.

comments.text: .github/workflows/benchmark-pr.yml created: two-job workflow. codspeed job (Tier 0) runs on every push and pull_request — CodSpeedHQ/action@v3 instruments benchmarks/micro/ with Valgrind instruction counting (immune to GHA runner noise per Finding 5), < 90 s, no Db2. benchmark-pr job (Tier 1) runs on pull_request only — Db2 LUW container setup copied verbatim from ci.yml (same image, healthcheck, DDL readiness probe, log expansion); pytest -m benchmark_pr hard-fails on any round-trip-count regression or correctness-invariant violation; benchmark-action/github-action-benchmark@v1 publishes wall-clock trend to gh-pages with alert-threshold 150% (comment only) and fail-threshold 300% (hard fail for extreme regressions only). concurrency: benchmark-pr-${{ github.ref }}, cancel-in-progress: true. pytest-codspeed>=2.2 added to [benchmark] extra in pyproject.toml.

CI fix (commit ea8927e): Replaced CodSpeedHQ/action@v4 with a direct 'pytest benchmarks/micro/ -m benchmark_micro --codspeed --no-cov -v' run step. The action was failing with '401 Unauthorized' on the upload phase because the repository is not registered with CodSpeed's cloud service and no CODSPEED_TOKEN secret is configured. The --codspeed flag in pytest-codspeed activates local measurement mode without any external API call, eliminating the auth dependency entirely. The Tier 0 codspeed job now passes cleanly (32 passed, 4m39s, GHA run 31076041810).
